_doc: Candidate RU VPS/hosting providers for the Phase 1 sensor, with ASNs resolved from
RIPEstat searchcomplete (holder names recorded verbatim so a wrong match is visible).
Inclusion here means 'a provider you might plausibly rent from', NOT 'approved'. The
screen is what produces a recommendation, and a sanctions hit ends the conversation.
Aeza is deliberately included: it is OFAC-designated, so it is the control case that
proves the sanctions screen actually fires.

providers.name: Selectel
providers.screen_review: Earlier hit was 'msk' from the AS handle SELECTEL-MSK, not a company name; handles are now stripped. No designation found. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: VDSina
providers.note: AS216071 is a UAE (FZCO) entity; only the RU-registered ASN is an RU vantage.

providers.name: Aeza
providers.note: CONTROL CASE: OFAC-designated 2025-07-01. Must come back as a sanctions hit.
providers.screen_review: DESIGNATED 2025-07-01 - AEZA GROUP LLC, AEZA INTERNATIONAL LTD, AEZA LOGISTIC LLC all on SDN. Do not transact. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: IHOR
providers.screen_review: Person-name collisions only: 'Ihor' is a common Ukrainian given name. No entity match. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: MTW
providers.screen_review: False positive: token 'ekspert' from the legal name 'JSC Mediasoft ekspert'; matched entities (RSV-EKSPERT, EMS EKSPERT, CHIP EKSPERT) are unrelated. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: Cloud.ru
holders: CLOUDRU-AS "Cloud Technologies" LLC trading as Cloud.ru

providers.name: Fornex
providers.note: Spanish entity with an RU-region ASN (48018); check which ASN a given plan lands in.
providers.screen_review: Earlier hit was the Spanish legal suffix 'S.L.'; now stopworded. No designation found. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: Rusonyx
providers.screen_review: False positive: token 'astra' from 'LLC ASTRA CLOUD'; all matches are DANA ASTRA / ASTRA GROUP, unrelated. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: FirstByte
providers.note: Same holder (FIRST SERVER LIMITED) as AS205090, the largest DC-side ASN in the gap read - so this is the one candidate with real OONI signal.
providers.screen_review: False positive: token 'first' from 'FIRST SERVER LIMITED'; matches are unrelated companies whose names begin with First. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: HOSTKEY
providers.note: Dutch entity selling RU-located servers; the legal counterparty is not Russian.
providers.screen_review: Earlier hit was the Dutch suffix 'B.V.'; now stopworded. No designation found. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: DDoS-Guard
providers.screen_review: False positive: token 'guard'; matches are IRGC entities. Reviewed 2026-08-27. NOTE: reputational//customer-base concerns about this provider are a separate question from sanctions.

providers.name: G-Core
providers.note: Luxembourg entity of Russian origin; included because it is a common suggestion, not because it is an RU vantage.
providers.screen_review: False positive on a generic token; no designation found. Luxembourg entity, not an RU vantage anyway. Reviewed 2026-08-27.

providers.name: EDIS
providers.note: GmbH selling a Moscow VPS from EUR 4.99. Registry agrees it is in Russia (213.183.56.0/24, netname EDIS-RU-NET, country RU, descr 'EDIS Infrastructure in Moscow') but the ROUTING DOES NOT: AS57169's only upstream for that prefix is AS56630 Melbikomas UAB (LT), and every observed path reaches it through European tier-1s (Cogent, Telia, Lumen, GTT, NTT) with no Russian ASN anywhere. So it may be a Russian postcode on a European path -- unverified whether TSPU applies. Pays cleanly by card via Stripe (no crypto rail needed), which is the opposite trade-off from the RU-entity candidates. Looking glass: 213.183.56.10.
providers.screen_review: No match. Reviewed 2026-09-09. Counterparty is the GmbH, not Melbicom; both screened.

providers.name: Melbicom
providers.note: Not a candidate itself; EDIS's sole upstream for the Moscow prefix and the maintainer of it (MELBICOM-MNT). Screened because LEGAL-RU.md says to screen affiliates, not just the counterparty.
providers.screen_review: Hit was the Lithuanian legal suffix 'UAB' matching UAB FLAVOUR LABS; now stopworded, same shape as the earlier s.l. and b.v. false positives. No designation found. Reviewed 2026-09-09.
